d:
A powerful Ganesh Vandana infused with contemporary Bollywood beats, this celebratory track features the dynamic vocals of Nakash Aziz and Vishal Dadlani, composed by Vishal & Shekhar with spirited lyrics by Amitabh Bhattacharya. A perfect blend of devotion and dance from the film Banjo.
Credits
Song: Om Ganapataye Namaha Deva
Film: Banjo
Singers: Nakash Aziz, Vishal Dadlani
Music: Vishal & Shekhar
Lyrics: Amitabh Bhattacharya
Lyrics of Om Ganapataye Namaha Deva - om ganpatye nam deva
